title: It's True Evil
bio: The fifth and final track recorded by JinnaWoods with periyuh in early 2022. Designed as a runway song like 'Devils', this track closed their brief collaboration. It was later remixed into 'EVIL' with a more experimental and haunting sound for *The Iconic Pop* remix album.
lyrics: JinnaWoods arrived to the Halloween Party
Now move your ass from the runway
Because JinnaWoods is gonna have a moment!
JinnaWoods arrived to the Halloween Party
